name: Ember Larder
tagline: The launchpad for the next great food brand — built in a kitchen you'll never have to own.
positioning: Ember Larder turns solo cooks and creators into delivery-only food brands with licensed pro kitchen access, brand ops, and one console for every marketplace.

hero.h1: Own the brand. Rent the fire.
hero.sub: Launch a delivery-only food label from a fully licensed pro kitchen you book by the hour — no lease, no buildout, no line cooks quitting on a Friday.

features.title: Kitchen on demand
features.description: Book fully licensed commissary stations by the hour across our national network. Walk in, cook, walk out. Your ingredients are prepped and waiting.

features.title: One menu, every marketplace
features.description: Publish once and Ember Larder syncs your menu, photos, and pricing to DoorDash, Uber Eats, and Grubhub — no copy-pasting into six dashboards.

features.title: Brand in a box
features.description: Generate packaging, a logo, and a storefront in an afternoon. Your first order can ship the same day you decide the concept exists.

features.title: Compliance, quietly solved
features.description: Permits, food-handler docs, and insurance certificates live in one vault and renew themselves before an inspector ever asks.

features.title: Live order routing
features.description: Tickets from every platform land in a single screen and route to the nearest open station, so a rush never becomes a meltdown.

features.title: Margins you can actually see
features.description: Track food cost, marketplace fees, and profit per dish in real time. Kill the concepts that lose money before they cost you a weekend.

testimonials.quote: I went from a supper club in my apartment to three delivery brands running out of one Ember Larder station. I have never signed a lease and I never will.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar

testimonials.quote: The compliance vault alone paid for itself. My inspector renewals used to eat a full weekend a month — now I forget they happen.
testimonials.name: Marcus Adeyemi

testimonials.quote: We tested nine menu concepts in a quarter and shut down six without ever building a restaurant. The margin dashboard makes every decision obvious.
testimonials.name: Dana Whitfield

pricing.blurb: For the first-time creator turning one recipe into one real brand.
For operators running multiple concepts out of shared stations.
For brand groups scaling across cities and kitchen networks.

homepage.footerBlurb: Ember Larder is the operating system for delivery-only food brands. Build the label. We'll keep the fire lit.
